meaning: Printed vet (bold, teal) in the Vocabulairelijst = the 0-2000 most frequent Dutch words.
note: Read off a photo of the Vocabulairelijst with freq_tier_from_photo.py (ink colour per line), then confirmed against enlarged crops of every block. Only the bold tier is coloured, so cursief (2000-5000) and plain (>5000) cannot be told apart this way and are both left out of this list.
